def: An agent that answers an open-ended question with a sourced written report by iterating between planning, searching and reading for minutes rather than seconds.
One independently searchable piece of a research question, produced by the planner so that searches can run in parallel.
Deciding which search hits are worth opening by scoring snippets and discounting by source kind, because reading a page costs far more than reading a snippet.
A small checkable statement extracted from a source, stored with its verbatim quote, document id and metadata such as date and publisher.
Checking in code that a quoted string really appears in the fetched source text, which catches fabricated citations but not misattributed ones.
Support for a claim from two or more independent sources that report the same thing.
The distinct underlying sources behind a set of documents, counting a news story that quotes a report as the report rather than as a second witness.
A check, before a report is delivered, that each citation resolves, each quote and number is supported by the cited claims, and each factual sentence is cited.
The share of citations that support their sentence, and the share of supported sentences that carry a citation.
The failure of a word-matching search when a document uses different words from the query, such as spent against spending.
An OpenAI benchmark of 1,266 questions that require persistent web browsing to find hard-to-find information and have short, easily checked answers.
